We receive many compliments when she has one one, which is frequently because of the variety of colors. The quality also seems good, and for the price is great. I definitely recommend these for other baby girls!

reviews.t: The variety of colors is perfect when trying to find the perfect shade to match ...
reviews.x: The variety of colors is perfect when trying to find the perfect shade to match an outfit. They also have your staple colors to coordinate with nearly anything! The size is perfect and does not look overwhelming on my little one's head. She has been wearing these since she was a month old and is now 7 months! Great purchase and a total steal for what you get.

I ordered these headbands for my seven month old daughter.  She has plenty of headbands, but many of them are beginning to leave marks on her growing head. I love them and I love the fact that she can wear them for extended periods of time without getting any marks!

I ordered this set of headbands so my daughter would be sure to have one to match any outfit!  They are so cute, great colors, and nice quality.  They were big on my newborn and still slide around on her at 8 weeks, but will fit for a while.  I would order again in a second.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soft, comfortable elastic that doesn't leave marks or indents on babies' heads.
Many customers love the wide variety of colors and find them great for matching outfits.
The headbands are widely described as cute and adorable, with pretty rosettes.
Several reviewers note the headbands fit well and will continue to fit as the baby grows.
A few reviewers report quality problems, including cheap-looking material, shedding rosettes, and visible hot glue.
